workspace.note: All mutation checks ran in this disposable local fixture. The real .demo-v2 user clarification was left pending.

observed_checks.name: context precedes producers
observed_checks.observed: Fresh fixture showed pending context before proposals. Explicit test actor answer started five producers and ingested eight proposals.

observed_checks.name: native lifecycle
observed_checks.observed: Opened MR from ordinary Git branch; draft/ready, close/reopen, title and description edit worked.

observed_checks.name: exact review records
observed_checks.observed: Individual approval and a two-item batch approval recorded displayed revision/version pins; both current approval counts became one.

observed_checks.name: thread resolution
observed_checks.observed: Posted comment and resolved its discussion thread from the native MR view.

observed_checks.name: trusted validation
observed_checks.observed: Ran platform checks on exact native revisions, including draft and closed requests; listed HTTP application checks appeared.

observed_checks.name: reported CI trust separation
observed_checks.observed: Reported passed check named trusted-validation on a new source revision remained declared/reported; required platform trusted-validation remained missing.

observed_checks.name: owner policy and dependencies
observed_checks.observed: Saved minimum approvals=1 policy as configured local owner; selected and saved native dependency.

observed_checks.name: external Git source staleness
observed_checks.observed: Created new source commit through ordinary git commit-tree/update-ref and delivered Git event. Native pointer changed, current approvals became zero, prior review displayed Historical, source-change notice appeared.

observed_checks.name: standalone queue advancement
observed_checks.observed: Prepared exact native composition, entered rationale, enqueued reviewed basis/head, processed one entry and observed merged MR and queue state.

observed_checks.name: blocked and stale queue controls
observed_checks.observed: Queue blocked missing approval. Adding new review/check evidence made the immutable old ticket needs_review; cancelled it explicitly.

observed_checks.name: merged composition revert
observed_checks.observed: Prepared inverse through merged MR action, inspected new review, then explicitly applied reviewed revert via decision CAS. Preparation itself did not advance canonical Git.

observed_checks.name: batch composition and stale dependency gate
observed_checks.observed: Prepared two native MRs as one checked composition. First apply was safely rejected for changed dependency revision. Renewed exact dependency declaration, prepared fresh composition, explicitly applied, and both MRs reconciled merged.

observed_checks.name: minimal default actionable decisions
observed_checks.observed: After restarting isolated server with latest engine module, default view rendered exactly two actionable decision cards; previously prepared settled native review had actionable=false and stayed hidden.

observed_checks.name: responsive layout
observed_checks.observed: 390x844 default view and native MR dialog had no horizontal overflow; desktop and mobile screenshots captured.

observed_checks.name: production UI build
observed_checks.observed: Vite build completed; CSS 26.67 kB, JS 285.47 kB uncompressed.

expected_rejections.action: batch apply with dependency pinned before source update
expected_rejections.reason: MR_BLOCKED: Review and redeclare the changed dependency revision
expected_rejections.result: canonical state stayed unchanged until explicit new reviewed composition

expected_rejections.action: process queued composition after changing review/evidence
expected_rejections.result: needs_review; no automatic rebase or fresh review

harness_notes: Some initial Playwright locators were ambiguous or used a mismatched button/summary label; they were corrected and resumed. These were harness failures, not successful product actions.
The long-running test server initially cached older backend modules. It was restarted only in the disposable fixture before final actionable-filter checks and captures.
limitations: Local native Artifacts-style MR/API behavior; no live Cloudflare account, Artifact remote, Container runtime or production credentials were used.
These finite browser scenarios do not establish general semantic correctness or coverage of every mutation and failure path.

Individual request_changes/dismiss actions, every reported-check state, queue crash recovery, fork picker and non-MR prepare action are implemented controls but were not each exercised in these browser passes. Backend suites are separate evidence.
The test actor context answer is distinct from the real unanswered user clarification.
